education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering

projects.title: Baja SAE A-Arms & Suspension Mounts
projects.subtitle: Purdue Baja SAE Suspension Components
projects.summary: Designed backup shock-to-upper A-arms for the 2027 car, reinforced the shock-to-lower suspension mounts under bump-case FEA, and built fabrication jigging for the lower A-arms.
details: Parametrically modeled front A-arms in SolidWorks for the shock-to-upper suspension architecture, the team's risk-mitigation backup to the new shock-to-lower (lower-arm) design for the 2027 car, optimizing geometry for maximum ground clearance while ensuring clean load paths.
Checked motion and interference for the upper-arm shock layout and integrated the components into the upper-level assembly of the shock-to-upper suspension.
Set up and iterated bump-case FEA for the full shock-to-lower suspension assembly planned for the car.
Reinforced three suspension mounts and added two A-arm supports, achieving a 1.3 Factor of Safety outside unmodeled weld regions under bump loading while maintaining component clearance.
Developed lower A-arm fabrication jigging to locate bent tubes, shock tabs, and fins in one setup using aluminum blocks, MDF cutouts, locating pins, and 3D-printed supports.

projects.title: Baja SAE Billet Aluminum Upright
projects.subtitle: Purdue Baja SAE Suspension Component
projects.summary: Redesigned the billet aluminum upright to cut mass 16% (1.35 → 1.13 lb) while holding a 1.3 Factor of Safety.
details: Redesigned the billet aluminum upright geometry from a 1.35 lb initial model, using FEA results to drive the changes.
Incorporated DFM input alongside the FEA results so the lighter geometry remains practical to machine from billet stock.
Reached 1.13 lb, a 16% mass reduction, at a 1.3 Factor of Safety.

projects.title: Formula SAE Welded Front Rockers
projects.subtitle: Purdue Formula SAE Suspension Component
projects.summary: Designed welded front suspension rockers achieving ~18.8% weight reduction while maintaining a 1.6 Factor of Safety.
details: Engineered a multi-piece fabricated suspension rocker in Siemens NX, replacing traditional billet stock with plate welded to a central structural sleeve
Designed to be manufactured with two cut pieces of sheet metal welded to a tube instead of using normal stock, which assisted in reducing weight.
Conducted linear static FEA studies in ANSYS Mechanical under peak braking and cornering load cases, reducing component mass by 18.8% while maintaining a 1.6 Factor of Safety.

projects.title: Four Bar Linkage Controller System
projects.subtitle: 3D-Printed Arduino-Integrated Mechanism
projects.summary: Designed and 3D-printed a four-bar linkage system integrated with an Arduino MEGA and stepper motor to execute a CNC-style homing sequence.
details: Analytically designed linkage paths and custom snap-fit pivot joints in Autodesk Fusion 360 to resist torsional forces.
Troubleshot and refined real-world friction issues by post-processing and lubricating joints to prevent stepper motor stalling.
Integrated an Arduino MEGA, motor controller, and limit switch to drive the linkage with a stepper motor.
Used AI-generated Arduino firmware for a calibration sequence that mimics CNC machine tool-length measurement and zero-positioning.

projects.title: Retrofit IoT Smart Lock
projects.subtitle: Electromechanical Door Automation
projects.summary: Designed a custom 3D-printed electromechanical mechanism to automate a deadbolt while preserving manual key operation.
details: Engineered a custom 1:1 spur gear train (21 teeth) using Machinery's Handbook standards to interface a 12V 6-RPM worm gear motor with a standard door deadbolt, designed to drive 90 degrees in 2.5 seconds.

Designed an internal lost-motion 'butterfly' mechanism within the driven gear, enabling 90 degrees of free rotation for manual locking and unlocking without backdriving the high-reduction motor assembly.
Collaborated cross-functionally with a Computer Engineering student to define system packaging and power architecture for an IoT smart lock triggered by a piezo-knock sensor and proximity connection.

Co-specified the 12V motor, 100g 7.4V 2000mAh Li-ion battery, and system power requirements to ensure the mechanism met the 25 kg-cm stall torque demand while achieving our shared target of a three-week battery life.

projects.title: Custom SFF PC Case
projects.subtitle: V1 Design Complete — Pivoting to V2
projects.summary: A dual-chamber small form factor PC case, engineered to thermally isolate the motherboard from the GPU and PSU across a central spine.
details: Designed an initial V1 dual-chamber chassis centered around a structural spine to efficiently package and organize core hardware components.
Engineered a symmetric bottom-intake/top-exhaust airflow scheme with a top-mounted 240mm AIO, fully isolating the motherboard and heatsinks from an RTX 5070 and SFX PSU.
Identified unresolved structural risks in the spine-to-panel mounting during design review; paused V1 to develop a V2 redesign utilizing a wrap-around sheet-metal shell for improved rigidity.

projects.title: GD&T 3D-Printed Instructional Models
projects.subtitle: General Tool Company Onboarding Project
projects.summary: Engineered custom physical models demonstrating True Position and MMC principles for intern training.
details: Designed physical hands-on models in CAD to demonstrate complex geometric dimensioning concepts.
3D printed interactive inspection fixtures to be used during onboarding for future engineering interns.
Designed to help interns and new hires in visualizing tolerance zones during drawing analysis.

projects.title: Automotive Electronics & Speedometer Retrofit
projects.subtitle: Custom Harnessing & Dashboard Integration
projects.summary: Integrated custom automotive head units, backup cameras, and aftermarket dash clusters.
details: Soldered custom wiring harnesses to integrate upgraded radios with factory wiring seamlessly.
Wired aftermarket interfaces for backup cameras and steering wheel control retention systems.
Retrofitted a modern digital speedometer cluster to preserve vehicle driver info displays post-radio replacement.
